display.purpose: Page-level section title. Deliberately normal-weight, not bold. The page heading announces; it does not shout.

headline.purpose: Subsection title. Bold (600) because dense forms below need separation.

body.purpose: Default text. Forms, table cells, paragraphs. 65–75ch line length where layout allows.

body-small.purpose: Help text under inputs, secondary table rows, tab subtitles.

label.purpose: Metadata: item short-id, slice prefix, timestamp.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Gold glow on focused buttons and inputs in modern surfaces. Replaces the legacy blue outline.

shadows.name: floating-surface
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, per-search popovers, comparison drill-downs. Paper hovering above paper.

shadows.name: subtle-lift
shadows.purpose: Single small bump used sparingly on interactive chips. Legitimate but rare.

motion.name: legacy-slow
motion.purpose: Existing transition pattern across legacy buttons. Grandfathered; do not extend.

motion.name: modern
motion.purpose: Recommended for new components. ease-out-quart; no bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: modern-fast
motion.purpose: Border-color and focus-ring changes on the dropdown-style controls in admin-ecn.css; their option rows fade the background in 0.08s.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Phone layout of the newer admin surfaces (css/dataimport.css at 40em; aa-isds.css and aa-params.css switch nearby, at 600px and 620px).

breakpoints.name: admin-shell
breakpoints.purpose: The main admin breakpoint (admin-ecn.css, css/aa-system.css, css/dataimport.css at 48em): below it the page background turns white and side-by-side blocks stack.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Statistics charts get a taller aspect ratio below it (`.aa-stat-chart`); aa-isds.css has a rule at the same width.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Below it the slice heading (`.slicehead`) gets extra left padding.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: The workhorse. Square, dense, near-black on warm background. Used for almost every admin action except publish/save.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.955rem; line-height: 16px; padding: 6px 12px; margin: 2px; background-color: var(--clr-dark, #1f1f1f); color: var(--clr-body, #f3f3f1); border: solid 1px transparent; border-radius: 0; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.5,1,0.89,1), color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.5,1,0.89,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background-color: var(--clr-basic-darker, #A8977A); color: var(--clr-body, #f3f3f1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(184, 162, 70, 0.20); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Publish / save / confirm only. The single saturated voice in the chrome.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.955rem; line-height: 16px; padding: 6px 12px; margin: 2px; background-color: var(--clr-green, #1eb585); color: var(--clr-body, #f3f3f1); border: solid 1px transparent; border-radius: 0; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.5,1,0.89,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #189869; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(184, 162, 70, 0.20); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent over warm surface. Use when an action is real but secondary in priority.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.955rem; line-height: 16px; padding: 6px 12px; margin: 2px; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color: var(--clr-text-accent, #6a5e22); border: solid 1px rgba(26,4,4,0.3); border-radius: 0; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.5,1,0.89,1), color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.5,1,0.89,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: var(--clr-basic-dark, #d5c2a4); color: var(--clr-dark, #1f1f1f); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(184, 162, 70, 0.20); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Dense, square, white on warm surface. Border is Margin Line; focus shifts to Hover Olive plus a gold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.955rem; line-height: 1.4; padding: 3px 4px; margin: 2px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--clr-dark, #1f1f1f); border: 1px solid var(--clr-border, #dcd5c2); border-radius: 0; box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 100%; transition: border-color 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.5,1,0.89,1), box-shadow 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.5,1,0.89,1); } .ds-input:focus, .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--clr-border-hover, #a59850); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(184, 162, 70, 0.20); }

components.name: Details Chip
components.description: The pill-shaped expander. Sole rounded primitive in the system. Toggleable affordance.
components.css: .ds-details summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 12px; margin-bottom: 0; display: inline-block; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border: solid 1px rgba(26,4,4,0.3); color: #61454A; border-radius: 13px; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.955rem; transition: background-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.5,1,0.89,1), color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.5,1,0.89,1); list-style: none; } .ds-details summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-details summary:after { content: ''; display: inline-block; border: solid 4px transparent; border-top-color: #61454A; margin-left: 6px; transform: translateY(2px); transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.5,1,0.89,1); } .ds-details[open] summary:after { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(180deg); } .ds-details summary:hover { background-color: var(--clr-basic-dark, #d5c2a4); color: var(--clr-dark, #1f1f1f); }

components.name: Stats Cell with In-Cell Bar
components.description: Numeric table cell with a 3px bar at the bottom encoding the value as length, and HSL-tinted hue swinging red→amber→green with --pct.
components.css: .ds-stat-table { border-collapse: collapse; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-stat-table thead th { padding: 4px 6px; text-align: right; background-color: var(--clr-basic-dark, #d5c2a4); color: rgb(0 0 0 / 80%); font-weight: 400; border-left: solid 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.45); border-top: solid 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.45); } .ds-stat-table tbody td { padding: 2px 6px; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-stat-table tbody td:first-child { text-align: left; background-color: #ffffff; } .ds-stat-table tbody tr:nth-of-type(even) td:first-child { background-color: #f3efe6; } .ds-stat-bar { background-image: linear-gradient(to right, var(--bar, #7a9) calc(var(--pct, 0) * 1%), transparent 0); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: left bottom; background-size: 100% 3px; } .ds-stat-cache { --bar: hsl(calc(var(--pct, 0) * 1.2), 60%, 55%); }

components.name: Drill-down Link
components.description: Inline link inside a table cell or diagnostic card. No underline by default; underlines on hover; inherits the cell's color for in-context use.
components.css: .ds-link-drill { color: #2F3D99; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; transition: color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.5,1,0.89,1); } .ds-link-drill:hover { color: #007ed7; text-decoration: underline; } .ds-link-drill:visited { color: #896996; } .ds-link-drill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(184, 162, 70, 0.20); border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Floating Popover
components.description: Dropdown / popover surface. Paper hovering above paper: warm-tinted shadow, near-white fill, no border decoration.
components.css: .ds-popover { display: inline-block; padding: 12px 16px; background-color: var(--clr-surface-popup, #fbfaf9); border: 1px solid var(--clr-border, #dcd5c2); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(60, 50, 20, 0.20); max-width: 280px; }

narrative.overview: APC-AA is the back office of a public-interest newsroom that has been running since 1999. Every screen is a layout slug for somebody else's published work; nothing in the chrome competes with the article it is helping to ship. The warm palette is newsprint and stained-pine desks, not Silicon Valley cream. The type sits in a tight 1.05x–1.1x scale because dense reference material is what editors actually read. The H1 is `font-weight: normal` on purpose: nothing in the admin is 'the headline', everything is the work. Aesthetic family is modern app shell calibrated down toward editorial-civic: cleaner type and rhythm than legacy CMS admins, dramatically less ornament than commercial dashboards, data-first throughout. Closer to a well-run public library than a startup.
keyCharacteristics: Warm earth palette (newsprint, sand, brass, olive ink). No cool greys.
Editorial type density: 13px root, 1.05–1.1 scale, font-weight: normal on H1.
Square by default. Border-radius is rare and earns its place (chips, dropdowns).
Flat by default. Shadows are warm-tinted and only appear on floating surfaces or focus.
Progressive disclosure as identity: clean default surface, full power one click away.
Vibrant green for *published* (not for 'delight') and warm red-orange for *wasted work* (not 'danger').

rules.name: The Earth-Only Rule
rules.body: Cool greys are forbidden. Every neutral is tinted warm. If a token wants to lean cool (#f5f5f7, #e0e0e0, blue-grey scales), it is the wrong choice, not a different choice.

rules.name: The One Saturated Voice Rule
rules.body: Published Green is the only saturated UI color in the chrome. Charts and diagnostic surfaces may use the data-state ramp; nothing else may go saturated.

rules.name: The Reserved-Red Rule
rules.body: Stop the Press red (#a02222) and Deadline Orange (#dd6644) are reserved for the data-state palette. Do not co-opt them for generic error/danger UI without a chart-shaped reason.

rules.name: The Normal-Weight H1 Rule
rules.body: Page-level H1 is font-weight: 400, never 600 or 700. The page heading announces, it does not shout.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numerics Rule
rules.body: Any table or chart cell that carries numeric data MUST set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Column alignment is part of the contract with the operator scanning for outliers.

rules.name: The 1.4-Line-Height Rule
rules.body: Line-height is 1.4 everywhere by default. Tighter (1.2) is allowed for ALL-CAPS micro-labels only; looser (1.6+) is allowed for paragraph-form help text inside <details> panels.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: New components ship flat. A shadow is added only when (a) the element floats above the page, (b) it carries focus, or (c) the user has the right to drag/rearrange it. Decorative shadow is forbidden.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow uses warm-tinted color (rgba(60, 50, 20, .X), rgba(184, 162, 70, .X), or a similar sand-brass family). Black shadows read as templated admin chrome — the design family we are not in.

dos: Do tint every neutral toward the warm-earth family. Cool greys are wrong, not different.
Do keep buttons square (border-radius: 0). Rounding a button means you have misread the system.
Do set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every numeric column or chart cell.
Do use font-weight: 400 on page-level H1. The page heading announces; it does not shout.
Do show real numbers. 'Cache hit ratio is 32%, below the 70% threshold.' Not 'Looks like caching could use some love!'
Do put depth one click away (<details>, drill-down link, tooltip on metric). Never hide information from a curious user; defer it.
Do use the gold Focus Ring shadow (0 0 0 3px rgba(184, 162, 70, .20)) on new components.
Do verify long-form translations (Czech, German) before declaring a layout done. Labels can be 1.5x to 2x the English length.
Do ship vanilla JS and small CSS where the choice exists. APC users include slow-bandwidth regions.
donts: Don't drift toward SaaS-cliché polish (Linear, Stripe dashboards, Vercel): hyper-polished cards, gradient accents, big hero numbers.
Don't import a generic Bootstrap admin theme look (AdminLTE, SBAdmin, 'Material Dashboard'): identikit blue-on-white cards.
Don't swing to dark observability (Grafana, Datadog): cold dark surfaces, neon traces, ops-engineer aesthetic.
Don't ape AI-app chat (Claude, Cursor): monochrome with one purple accent, soft pillowy shadows.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left: 4px solid X). Full borders, background tints, leading numbers, or nothing.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient). Single solid color. Emphasis via weight or size.
Don't add decorative shadow. Shadows belong to floating surfaces, focus states, and drag affordances.
Don't use #000 or #fff as a token. Press Black (#1f1f1f) and Press Paper (#f3f3f1) tinted toward the brand.
Don't introduce em dashes in user-facing UI copy. Commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't add modal dialogs as the first thought. Inline <details>, popovers, and progressive disclosure exhaust their alternatives first.
Don't ship without verifying prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is respected for any animation longer than 200ms.
